title: Federated Dataset Simulation: Inducing Label-Free Heterogeneity Across Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.19975v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated Learning enables collaborative model training across decentralized clients without sharing raw data. While the field has seen rapid growth, the datasets underpinning FL evaluation have not kept pace: real federated datasets remain scarce, and most studies rely on small-scale centralized classification datasets partitioned via Dirichlet label skew, a one-dimensional proxy for the multi-dimensional heterogeneity present in real federations. Moreover, label-based partitioning is by construction inapplicable to non-classification tasks such as segmentation and detection, for which no principled simulation method exists. We cast the conversion of centralized datasets into federated benchmarks as the task of Federated Dataset Simulation (FDS), and decompose it into a representation function $\Phi$ and an assignment mechanism $\pi$. translated_title: 联邦数据集模拟：跨任务诱导无标签异质性
translated_abstract: 联邦学习使去中心化客户端之间无需共享原始数据即可协作训练模型。尽管该领域发展迅速，但支撑联邦学习评估的数据集却未能跟上步伐：真实的联邦数据集仍然稀缺，大多数研究依赖于通过狄利克雷标签偏斜进行划分的小规模中心化分类数据集，这只是真实联邦中存在的多维异质性的一种一维代理。此外，基于标签的划分在结构上不适用于分割和检测等非分类任务，对于这些任务目前尚无有原则的模拟方法。我们将中心化数据集转换为联邦基准的任务定义为联邦数据集模拟，并将其分解为表示函数 $\Phi$ 和分配机制 $\pi$。我们提供了两种无标签的实现方式——通过预训练模型嵌入进行几何划分……
tldr: 该论文提出联邦数据集模拟框架，将中心化数据集转换为联邦基准，通过无标签方法为分类、分割、检测等多任务诱导真实的多维异质性，解决了现有联邦学习评估依赖标签偏斜划分且不适用于非分类任务的局限。
